rounds.evidence: Previous UX evaluation was compared with the .9 calibration policy; scalar contract and absolute F versus original residual semantics were agreed before implementation. No new settings/buttons or required B_run/Scale fields.

Actual source-linked WPF build 0 warnings/0 errors; new 43 cases and all existing 19 modes preserve raw/selection/keyboard/keypad/compact/theme/scope/modal guards. Twenty modes total 1,074/1,074; 30 exact input hashes and embedded report hashes matched.

Both independently opened final Dark notebook and Light wide PNGs. Actual residual +2/-1, saved Review +10/+20 and unsaved working F +11/+19.5 are legible and distinct. F-only gray/edit and original-NG red, large map, folded table, single Cell save, original theme and no unwanted scroll/clipping confirmed. No further UI source change requested.

uiChanges: A single passive selected-point readout adds saved Review and optional unsaved recommended/edited F; map remains actual residual Level.
Single short Cell n correction-save button remains the primary save; confirmations show model/value/Cell scope and remeasurement consequence in 3-4 lines.
Per-Cell and other-Cell unsaved counts override older CSV-verified text. CSV consistency success is named saved/re-measure required, never physical precision pass.
Raw camera residual, operator approval, absolute F input, copied F and file input are distinguished. F-only is editable/copyable but does not create a residual, a Level1 zero or a camera sample.
Original NG/error stays colored as the original physical result even after manual approval; pending edits are a passive text marker.

Default scatter is original residual; second option is working absolute Review F with origin counts, no physical residual tolerance box and no precision-pass claim. Same pan/zoom/hit/geometry/selection logic.
Export menu explicitly names last saved whole-model CSV. Undo/Redo tooltips name the target Cell/time.
intentionalExistingTestMigrations: Old .8 UI assumption F=raw deviation is replaced only at the new Manual recommendation display boundary; tests now consume Controller-resolved immutable F and do not compute an unverified F in View.
Old WORKING residual population expectations become explicit original residual or working Review F populations. Existing test count 1,031 stays, plus new 43 checks.

Synthetic basis flags/recommended F are explicitly provided by fake Controller fixtures. Native basis proof/math/persistence is independently tested by Core/Controller/Backend, not inferred from UI passes.
Old long modal text and old force/keypad labels changed to short operational wording; stale/version/controller/reentry/cancel guards and raw immutability assertions remain.
operationalLimits: No actual equipment App/Root/Manager/vendor runtime/motion/Vision/operating CSV/laser executed by this UI run.
UI only consumes Controller-provided recommendation/proof; the 43 cases do not establish physical accuracy or the native calibration formula.
Gray can mean no actual residual, including absolute edit; saved Review and working F are readable separately.
Saving/verifying a CSV is not completion of post-correction measurement.
